name: reboards
title: ReBoards
description: Revamped agile boards: work with relations, group subtasks under their parent, use multiple swimlane levels and plan in time.
changeNotes:
Version 1.4.0:
- Add a Gantt layout with up to three planning levels, due dates, persons needed from the estimate, subtask trees and relation arrows.
- Reschedule and plan issues in the Gantt layout by dragging, with a confirmation before saving.
- One Time & planning setup for the time and Gantt layouts; 1.3.0 time setups are converted automatically.
- Time rows per sprint, day, week, month or quarter, with work per row and due dates on cards.
- The toolbar fits narrow windows; the Show menu is now the ⋯ menu.
